title: The checker's file list (`relay changed --own`) has no…
what: bin/relay:468: MEDIUM: F4 the checker's file list (`relay changed --own`) has no archive filter, so a re-check after an archive commit counts the archive as open +1
why: Found outside the archive-inert change (24 Oct, wave 1): a re-check after an archive commit counts the archive as open, so the checker and the merge guard disagree on what an archive changes.
failing_case: Mark on C, then any archive commit that the merge refuses (for example with a docs edit, F1) or any re-check for another
reason: the checker runs `relay changed --own -C <wt> <reviewed>` and gets every openspec/specs and
openspec/changes/archive path; with `Fixes: none` that is open +1 "changed since the review", so the new mark has open 1
and the merge stays refused. Should be: the checker and the merge guard agree on what an archive changes.
pass_cases: 1. `relay changed --own --archive -C <wt> <C>` after an archive-only commit prints nothing.
2. Same with a README.md edit in the commit prints README.md only.
3. `relay changed --own -C <wt> <C>` without the flag is unchanged.
